summary: Iteration 2 additions fully tested. All 7 backend pytest cases pass (avg_sla_days present=72.8; timeseries granularity day>week>month with totals conserved; POST /api/import happy path returns rows=3000 and updates GET / count; rejects .txt with 400; rejects xlsx missing required columns with 400). Frontend E2E passes: 5 KPI cards including kpi-sla shows '72.8d'; header shows all 4 buttons (btn-import, btn-refresh, btn-print-pdf, btn-export-csv); granularity-toggle with day/week/month works and syncs g=week into URL (and drops g when day); direct navigation /?categories=Update+Rekening pre-loads dashboard filtered to 327 records; clicking status-legend-Pending adds statuses=Pending to URL; import-dialog opens, import-submit disabled until file picked and enables after file selection.

issues: Typo: subtitle shows 'DAYLY ACTIVITY TREND' when granularity=day. GRAN_LABELS['day']+'ly' produces 'Dayly'. Should special-case to 'Daily'.
Repeated console warnings on mount: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from ResponsiveContainer (transient during first paint). Non-blocking but noisy.

action_items: Optional: fix 'Dayly' → 'Daily' subtitle in TimeSeriesChart.jsx (use a labels map for adverb form).
Optional: silence Recharts width/height(-1) warnings by ensuring parent has explicit height or setting minHeight on ResponsiveContainer wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: Import endpoint persists uploaded file by overwriting /app/backend/data/data_dummy_3000.xlsx. If a subsequent import fails validation there is no rollback of DF (fine because validation happens before assignment), but the on-disk file overwrite is destructive. Consider writing to a timestamped filename or keeping a backup.
compute_sla assumes 'Tanggal Proses Maker' column exists and is a datetime; import path normalizes it but not all uploaded schemas may include it - handled with a None return, OK.
Global mutable DF across requests is not thread-safe under high concurrency; acceptable for demo but flag for production.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing /app/backend/data/data_dummy_3000.xlsx and a tmp_path-generated 2-column xlsx for the missing-columns rejection test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers iter2 endpoints. BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env fallback. Chart drill-down click on Recharts <path> is skipped in Playwright (SVG click flaky); status-legend-<Status> buttons are the reliable path and used in tests. URL uses react-router useSearchParams; arrays are comma-joined so 'categories=A,B' or 'categories=A&categories=B' both work server-side via parse_multi.
